Dead Cells launched officially on Steam on August 6, 2018.
Dead Cells' developer is Motion Twin.
Motion Twin was founded in France.
The last French presidential election within the 2010-2020 decade occurred on May 7, 2017.
The domain motiontwin.com was created on July 4, 2003.
The time between the May 7, 2017 election and Dead Cells' Steam release on August 6, 2018 is 1 year and 91 days.
The time between the May 7, 2017 election and the Motion Twin domain creation on July 4, 2003 is 13 years and 307 days.
